title: vLLM-Copilot Model Entry
description: One entry of the `vllm-copilot.models` array in VS Code settings. Each entry is SELF-CONTAINED: it carries its own serverUrl, requestHeaders, params, budgets, and modes. There is NO global server. This schema mirrors `ModelConfig` in src/config.ts.

serverUrl.description: REQUIRED. OpenAI-compatible base URL of the server hosting this model (e.g. http://localhost:8000/v1). There is no global server — every model targets its own. Must be non-empty.

id.description: REQUIRED. Unique entry key. The Add flow uses "<model> on <host>". Used as the wire model id when vllmModelId is unset. Must be non-empty.

serverType.description: Backend protocol. Default: vllm. Missing/omitted always means vllm. Set explicitly for non-vLLM backends.

serverDisplayName.description: Optional human-friendly name for this server, shown in the dashboard tree and the Model Settings server dropdown instead of the raw URL. Server-level (stored per-model): the dashboard uses the first non-empty value among the models sharing this server identity (URL + headers). Set via the dashboard's Rename Server context action; empty/omitted falls back to the server URL. Not applicable to OpenRouter relays.

vllmModelId.description: Actual model id on the server (e.g. Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B). Allows several entries with different id values to point at the same server model. Defaults to id.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the model picker. Defaults to the id.

family.description: Model family identifier (e.g. qwen3_5, deepseek_v4, llama). Auto-detected from HuggingFace config.model_type; optional.

provider.description: OpenRouter only. Exact provider slug to pin routing via provider: { only: [slug] }. Omit/empty = Auto.

routingMode.description: OpenRouter only. How OpenRouter sorts/chooses providers when routing is Auto. Ignored when a provider is pinned.

requestHeaders.description: HTTP headers sent with every request to THIS model's server only (auth, routing). e.g. { "Authorization": "Bearer <key>" }.

maxOutputTokens.description: Output budget. NUMBER = single cap, no dropdown. ARRAY = ordered response-length choices (strictly descending, FIRST element = default and desired budget) shown as a second model-picker dropdown ('Output length'). Array entries above the model's clamped ceiling are dropped; fewer than two usable values = no dropdown (no auto-derived ladder). When the dropdown exists the user's pick OWNS max_tokens AND is the advertised output budget — a shorter pick grows the prompt budget (context - output). Always clamped to the context window and the server-reported output ceiling.

maxInputTokens.description: Auto-computed as the server context window minus the EFFECTIVE output budget (the resolved max_tokens: the Output length pick when maxOutputTokens is an array > modelModes[selected].max_tokens > defaultParams.max_tokens > maxOutputTokens). Only set to reduce further — never higher.

estimateCharsPerToken.description: Average chars-per-token for local token estimation.

defaultParams.description: Model-scope request params (raw vLLM request-body keys, snake_case). Layered under modelModes (a selected mode overrides these). The known vLLM parameter vocabulary is enumerated in the referenced definition; UNKNOWN KEYS ARE ALSO ALLOWED and passed through to the request body verbatim, so backend-specific parameters still work.

modelModes.description: Switchable named presets shown in the model picker. Each key is a user-visible mode label (e.g. "Think", "No Think"); each value is a params object merged into the request body when that mode is active. Per-mode sampling params override `defaultParams`; params set nowhere are omitted so the server's own default applies. Toggle reasoning via chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking or reasoning_effort.

additionalProperties.description: Request params for this mode. Same vocabulary as defaultParams.

defaultMode.description: Mode active before the user picks one. Must match one of the modelModes keys; otherwise the first key is used.

streamInactivityTimeout.description: SSE stream inactivity timeout in ms. 0 = disabled (wait indefinitely).

initialResponseTimeoutMs.description: Budget in ms for the server to send the first response headers. 0 = wait indefinitely. Raise it for slow-starting servers (model load / queue backlog).

autoContinueRetries.description: Auto-retry count for empty/truncated responses (assistant prefill). 0 = off.

systemMessageReplacementsFile.description: Path to a JSON file of { ruleName, find, replace } pairs applied to every system message. Recommended: .vllm/prompt-replacements.json

cost.description: Optional per-model cost rates for the dashboard Token Usage tracker. All rates per 1,000,000 tokens in currency units.

output.description: Cost per 1,000,000 output tokens (includes reasoning tokens).

currency.description: Display unit. "AI Credits" = compare with Copilot picker (1 credit = $0.01, enter credits directly).

requestParams.description: vLLM request-body parameters. KEYS ARE snake_case (top_p, maxOutputTokens is an entry field, NOT a param). Any param you do not set is OMITTED from the request, so the server's own default applies. The properties below are the KNOWN, documented vLLM vocabulary; other keys are NOT rejected — they are passed through verbatim so newer or backend-specific parameters still reach the server. See docs/configuration-reference.md for the full table.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. 0 = greedy. Omitted when unset — the server's default applies.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling threshold. Omitted when unset — the server's default applies.

include_stop_str_in_output.description: Include the stop string in the output (vLLM-only).

ignore_eos.description: Ignore EOS and keep generating; use with min_tokens (vLLM-only).

min_tokens.description: Minimum output tokens before stop sequences are honored.

bad_words.description: Words the model must not generate (vLLM-only).

structured_outputs.description: Token-level constraints: json, regex, choice, or grammar; mutually exclusive (vLLM-only, vLLM >= 0.12).

chat_template_kwargs.description: vLLM chat template params. Common keys: enable_thinking (bool), preserve_thinking (bool), reasoning_effort (string).

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort. vLLM maps 'high'/'max' → enable_thinking=true, 'none' → false (auto-inject). May also be placed inside chat_template_kwargs.

allowed_token_ids.description: Restrict generation to these token IDs (vLLM-only; niche).

max_tokens.description: Output token budget for this scope — sent to the server as max_tokens. Only consulted when maxOutputTokens is a plain number (no Output length dropdown): a dropdown pick always wins over mode and defaultParams values. Always clamped to the model's context window AND the server-reported output ceiling (maxOutputTokens). Prefer the ARRAY form of maxOutputTokens over per-mode max_tokens for length choices.

model.description: FORBIDDEN — reserved by the runtime (chatProtocol.ts strips it); the model id is derived from the entry, never from params.

messages.description: FORBIDDEN — reserved by the runtime (chatProtocol.ts strips it); messages are built by the extension.

stream.description: FORBIDDEN — reserved by the runtime (chatProtocol.ts always forces stream: true).

stream_options.description: FORBIDDEN — reserved by the runtime (chatProtocol.ts sets stream_options.include_usage).
